summary.zh: 同步上游稳定版 v0.449.0：新增 DeepSeek 视觉模型支持、Beta 渠道邀请门、AGENTS.md 角色文件、持久化存储恢复和 Windows 安装器种子修复；重新生成持久化指纹和 CLI 闭包收据。
summary.en: Syncs upstream stable v0.449.0 (DeepSeek vision model support, beta-channel updater invite gate, AGENTS.md persona adoption, persistence store recovery, Windows installer seed fix) and regenerates persistence receipts for the v0.449.0 effective tree.

title.zh: DeepSeek 模型可以直接接收图片
title.en: DeepSeek models can receive images directly

summary.zh: 新增 DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision（实验版），并移除官方 DeepSeek 端点上旧的图片拦截。只要模型明确声明支持图片，Hana 就会按模型协议直接发送图像；未声明图片能力的文本模型保持原有行为。
summary.en: DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision (Experimental) is now available, and the previous image block on official DeepSeek endpoints has been removed. When a model explicitly declares image support, Hana sends images directly using that model's protocol; text-only models keep their existing behavior.

details.zh: 内置模型词典加入 DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision（实验版），提供 100 万 token 上下文、最高 38.4 万 token 输出、推理与图片输入能力。
details.en: The built-in model catalog now includes DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision (Experimental), with a 1-million-token context window, up to 384,000 output tokens, reasoning, and image input.

details.zh: 此前即使模型声明支持图片，官方 DeepSeek 端点上的图像也会被静默转交给辅助视觉模型或替换成占位文字；现在会直接发送，错误声明则由 API 返回明确错误。
details.en: Previously, images on official DeepSeek endpoints could be silently rerouted to the auxiliary vision model or replaced with placeholder text even when the model declared image support. Images are now sent directly, while an incorrect capability declaration produces a visible API error.

sources.title: feat(models): support DeepSeek's vision model by removing the provider-level image gate

title.zh: 重新生成持久化指纹和 CLI 闭包收据
title.en: Regenerate persistence fingerprint and CLI closure receipts

summary.zh: 上游 v0.449.0 新增自动化存储恢复和 cron 存储恢复写入点后，持久化指纹和 CLI 闭包收据需要从有效代码树重新生成，否则 CI 指纹校验测试会失败。
summary.en: After upstream v0.449.0 added automation store failure recovery and cron-store recovery write points, the persistence schema fingerprint and CLI runtime closure receipts must be regenerated from the effective tree or CI fingerprint tripwire tests fail.

details.zh: 指纹从 sha256:968b647f...（v0.446.6）更新为 sha256:fc1e4cac...（v0.449.0），标记为兼容性新增，无 DATA_EPOCH 变更。
details.en: Fingerprint updated from sha256:968b647f... (v0.446.6) to sha256:fc1e4cac... (v0.449.0), classified as a compatible addition with no DATA_EPOCH change.

details.zh: CLI 闭包从 9,686 文件更新为 9,690 文件。
details.en: CLI closure updated from 9,686 files to 9,690 files.

sources.title: fix(receipts): regenerate persistence fingerprint and CLI closure for v0.449.0
